concerns.text: The plan cites two verified CSV sources (https://huggingface.co/datasets/leeroy-jankins/NIST-AI-Risk-Management-Framework/... and https://huggingface.co/datasets/Raziel1234/WebBooks-1/...), but these datasets do not contain polymer SMILES strings or degradation pathway labels required by FR‑001 and FR‑002. Consequently the dataset is inappropriate for training a GNN to predict polymer degradation pathways; the fallback to a rule‑based synthetic SMILES generator does not provide a real, verifiable dataset and violates the requirement to use *verified* polymer degradation records.
